place: Chaweng, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Contemporary Two-Bedroom Hillside Pool Villa with Office in Chaweng
blurb: One of just two contemporary villas in a boutique hillside development above Chaweng, set roughly 180 m above sea level for panoramic views across the island and the Gulf. Completed and move-in ready — two en-suite bedrooms plus a flexible office that converts to a third, open-plan living opening to a private 8 × 3 m pool and wide terraces, on its own freehold plot. ฿23,900,000.
detail:
One of only two private villas in a boutique hillside development above Chaweng, this completed home sits roughly 180 metres above sea level, angled to capture a panoramic sweep across the island and out to the Gulf of Thailand. The elevated setting buys privacy, constant natural light and a quiet remove from the beach without giving up the view.

The villa is arranged over two floors plus a separate master pavilion, with an open-plan living and kitchen area opening through floor-to-ceiling glass onto generous terraces and the pool. Two en-suite bedrooms are joined by a dedicated office with a sofa that works equally well as a guest room, and the layout can be reconfigured to a full three bedrooms. The master pavilion has its own en-suite and steps straight out to the terrace and pool.

Architecturally the house pairs clean European lines with an Asian minimalism of warm natural materials and tropical openness. Outside are a private 8 × 3 m pool, around 100 m² of panoramic terraces and covered parking. Services are built for hillside self-sufficiency: a grid-connected solar option, EV-charging provision, a private 220 m deep well and a rainwater-collection system.

The villa occupies its own 600 m² freehold plot, with roughly 195 m² of interior space within about 380 m² of total built area. It is available freehold through a Thai company structure or on a registered leasehold. This is the completed villa of the pair; the neighbouring three-bedroom villa is available off-plan and can be purchased separately. Floor plans, specifications and ownership options on request.
